headline: Fed Chair Powell: It is *very premature* to think about pausing rate hikes
quote: It is very premature to be thinking about pausing.
title: Powell, Nov 2022: Very premature to think about pausing rate hikes
caption: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 75 basis points in November 2022. Chair Jerome Powell emphasized that rates need to rise further to combat inflation.
comment: Do you think the Fed kept raising rates for too long?
